note: Manufacturer (own plant, Faridabad, Haryana; registered address O-63 Ground Floor, Lajpat Nagar-II, New Delhi per customs record) — role: manufacturer, not a trader. No rejection grounds: legal entity active, shipments ongoing into 2026.
